description: A flattened JWS with protected header {"alg":"HS256"} and b64 false in the unprotected header; the payload "test" is canonical base64url that re-encodes to itself, so the MAC (Python hmac, A.1 key) is correct whether b64 is read as false or true: b64 must be in the protected header (ADR 0026 §2 step 4)
